identification: Six Tasmanian etched soda syphons in a blue painted 'Property of Abbotts' crate: clear Bradbury's Tasmania (lady trade mark, red plastic head), clear DCF Devonport (Dixon), clear Dixon & Co Melbourne (lion), two cobalt blue syphons (one Abbott's Tasmania champion prize medal type, the other etched with a star device, Launceston?), clear monogram C syphon probably Launceston. Photo 5 shows the two blue ones clearly; the clear ones are common to modest.

searches_tried: comps.py (pipeline and work) for soda syphon, syphon blue, syphon Tasmania, Abbotts crate; WebSearch for Tasmanian blue syphon Abbotts sold and Bradbury's cobalt Launceston; opened ABCR Auction 48, 52, 21, 34 pages. Resale evidence thin: only ABCR (specialist bottle house) found, no dated cobalt blue Bradbury or Launceston blue result. Key finding: ABCR blue Abbotts singles A$80 and A$150, clear Tasmanian syphons about A$25-55 each, so resale for the six plus crate looks roughly $250-450 at best, mostly from the two blues; Gowans room paid far more for syphon crates ($430, $950, $400), which is a cost warning. eBay sold (Chrome) and Antique Bottle auctions (ABCR search) would add more; Facebook/Gumtree asking not checked.
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold listings: 'cobalt blue soda syphon Tasmania' and 'Abbotts Tasmania blue soda syphon'; also abcrauctions.com.au archive search 'syphon Tasmania' for more dated blue results.
viewing_check: Check the two blue syphons for base chips, cracks, and exact etching (Abbott's wording, and read the star-device one: maker/town); check heads are original and spouts marked; check the crate stencil; look for neck or lip damage under the metal heads and any hazing. Photograph the base and etching of each blue syphon.
